headline: This New Mac Malware Uses Your Own System Against You to Steal Your Password
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its strong mainstream appeal and practical value for the large Mac user base. The story has high clickability, playing on the surprise of a sophisticated new threat to a platform often seen as secure, and the 'how it affects me' angle is direct—it steals passwords and crypto. Furthermore, the subject lends itself to multiple engaging formats, such as a 'how to protect yourself' guide or an explainer on its 'clever' techniques.
summary: Researchers have discovered a new, highly stealthy macOS malware named PamStealer that masquerades as a popular clipboard app to steal user passwords and cryptocurrency.

source_articles.title: Newly discovered PamStealer isn't your typical macOS malware
source_articles.excerpt: The discovery underscores the increased effort being poured into Mac infostealers.
